text:
How to create your own TREND AI FAN CAM video?

- Upload your photo to GPT Image 2 and use a prompt to create your fan cam scene.
- Then bring that scene into Seedance 2.0 to turn it into a video with motion, reactions, and dynamic camera movement.

Leave a comment saying “seedance,” and we'll send you the prompt.

Try it now on AITOPIA⚡
https://t.co/7nIcyAlk1D
content:
Upload your photo to GPT Image 2 and prompt it to generate a fan-cam scene image.  
Import the generated scene image into Seedance 2.0 and animate it into a video by prompting for motion, reactions, and dynamic camera movement.
